meaningKo: 이전에 비해 더 많은 책임을 지다, 더 잘하다
exampleEn: He really needs to step up his performance in the next meeting.
exampleKo: 그는 다음 회의에서 자신의 성과를 정말 더 잘해야 해.
gameExamples: She decided to step up her efforts to complete the project on time.
In difficult situations, it's important to step up and show leadership.
The team needs someone to step up and take charge of the new initiative.
